provenance.execution: Original ZIP programmatically opened in local analysis container; no third-party raw file redistributed
provenance.independent_numerical_crosscheck: All 4 sites x 3 model predictions agree with independently fitted NumPy ridge normal-equations within 1e-8 absolute prediction error

quality.field_S_marker_calls: SC coded 0 = A at S-locus; SI coded 1 = D at S-locus, fully confounded

models.M1: M0 + log1p((AH+BF source visit sequence counts)/(individual source open flower-hours))
models.M2: M0 + log1p((all pollinator source visit sequence counts)/(individual source open flower-hours))
models.validation: Leave complete original site out across BOTH years (4 site folds)
models.scaling: training-site fold only, predictors standardized, intercept unpenalized
models.inclusion: complete source seed count, total flowering, flowering time, source positive flower-hours; no outcome-informed filtering
models.predeclared_gate: pooled M0_minus_M1_MSE > 0 AND at least three of four full-site folds have M0_minus_M1_MSE > 0

scientific_bounds: Same original trial programme, four sites, not four independent study programmes
S locus marker call is confounded with field SC/SI category, so genetic compatibility is not independently identified
Observed guild AH/BF visitation is not measured compatible pollen deposition
Lifetime total flowers covariate requires information not available for an early warning
Seed total is a source seed count, not a verified viable next-generation offspring cohort
Not a prospective temporal/causal evaluation; site held-out association only
No individual-based p-values or universal natural effect claim
Original authors already established SC seed advantage and seed discounting
